name: Rossell Techsys Ltd
title: Rossell Techsys Ltd - 544294 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Revenue up 87% to INR485 crore with EBITDA margin compressing to about 13.6%, management attributes it to qualification investment and guides FY27 growth similar to FY26 with a QIP planned, no numeric margin guidance beyond 17-22% band.

capex.quote: we have taken a strategic decision to lease an additional facility of approximately 210,000 square feet in close proximity to our existing operations

triggers.label: Inventory coverage 10 to 7.67 months

triggers.highlight: Inventory coverage improved significantly from 10 months

triggers.label: Growth FY27 similar to FY26 (~87%)
